note: Physical GPU 0 and 1 on this shared 4x3090 host. Launch with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1 so torch sees them as cuda:0 (physical 0) and cuda:1 (physical 1); device_map='balanced' then splits Qwen3-30B-A3B INT8 weights across just these two visible devices. GPU 3 was occupied by another user's process (~15GB, 96% util) as of 2026-07-21, so this run uses GPU 0/1 instead. max_memory rebalanced 0:23GiB/1:21GiB (was 22/22) after phase0 run showed cuda:1 landing at 22.52GB reserved (over the 22.5GB script budget) while cuda:0 only reached 20.72GB -- shifting the cap nudges accelerate's balanced placement toward cuda:0's slack.
